title: Red-Team vs. Blue-Team Control Eval Replication on Open-Source Models

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: replicate control evals at accessible scale -> document methodology for community -> enables broader adoption of control eval methodology. Replication studies fill a real gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing both red-team and blue-team components, setting up monitoring and output filtering, and measuring cost ratios. The full red-team/blue-team framework is substantially beyond beginner capabilities.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Full control eval implementation with two adversarial teams, monitoring infrastructure, and cost analysis. Extremely broad scope even in simplified form. Well beyond 30 hours for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
